_meta.note: Captured off the wire: one real turn, `opencode acp` 1.19.1 driving a local Ollama model (llama3.2 3b, num_ctx 16384) reached through opencode's @ai-sdk/openai-compatible provider on a loopback endpoint, with a throwaway HOME and the project's `permission` set to ask. A SLICE: the initialize response, then the tool-call frames of the FIRST of the three bash calls the model made, then the turn's usage_update and stopReason. The 77 agent_message_chunk frames, the session/new response and the other two calls (rejected the same way) are omitted for length. The call FAILED, and that is real too: the model passed timeout as the string "null", so the harness rejected the arguments against its own schema. Nothing ran, and the rejection happens before any permission check -- which is why this turn carries no session/request_permission frame. Reduced at capture through scripts/capture_acp_compaction.py's own reduce_frames: the product's redact_text scrub, the scratch working directory replaced with <cwd> and the home directory with ~, the session id replaced with the synthetic opencode-session-1 and message ids with msg-N, the available_commands_update inventory dropped, and each configOptions select cut to its current option.
